content: Microsoft documents differences in VSTest/MTP zero-test handling, version-dependent minimum-test and skipped-test behavior. GitHub upload-artifact defaults to warning when no files match. Project inference: compare expected required IDs against executed non-skipped result IDs and exact artifact manifest; prove fail-closed missing engine, zero discovery, skipped cases, absent report, timeout and failed child processes under selected versions. Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/testing/migrating-vstest-microsoft-testing-platform https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/tools/dotnet-test-mtp https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact
